name: Klint Kubiak's Motion & Split-Zone / Leak Family
description: A masterclass in modern Shanahan-Kubiak sequencing. By marrying heavy 12-personnel condensed formations, pre-snap glide/orbit motion, and under-center split-zone run mechanics, Kubiak presents an identical visual picture before unleashing devastating intermediate Dagger shots, explosive backside Y-Leaks, and rapid perimeter tosses.
